sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Staff"."Tourist_Attraction_ID" AS e, "Ref_Attraction_Types"."Attraction_Type_Description" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Staff" JOIN "Tourist_Attractions" ON "Tourist_Attractions"."Tourist_Attraction_ID" = "Staff"."Tourist_Attraction_ID" JOIN "Ref_Attraction_Types" ON "Ref_Attraction_Types"."Attraction_Type_Code" = "Tourist_Attractions"."Attraction_Type_Code" GROUP BY "Staff"."Tourist_Attraction_ID", "Ref_Attraction_Types"."Attraction_Type_Description"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of Staff records (all level)
rank within the group by number of Staff records, keep the top 3
